broadcasts.title: Routine traffic
broadcasts.text: Kestrel Seven, your replacement transfer relay is held at North Ridge Supply. Inspect the cabinet before collecting it. Leave the standby battery charged.

broadcasts.title: North Ridge bulletin
broadcasts.text: The regional clinic reports several unusual incidents overnight. Residents are asked to avoid the treatment entrance. Regular deliveries are running late.

broadcasts.title: Travel advisory
broadcasts.text: Police advise against using the western town junction following attacks on responders. Keep clear of crowds. Do not approach people behaving erratically.

broadcasts.title: Dispatch interruption
broadcasts.text: Kestrel Seven, the supply truck will not reach your site. Keep your provisions. We have lost contact with the town crew. Maintain your local equipment.

broadcasts.title: Emergency notice
broadcasts.text: Reports confirm people rising after fatal injuries. The infection has spread beyond the regional clinic. Remain indoors where possible. Prepare drinking water, food, and heating fuel.

broadcasts.title: Emergency power
broadcasts.text: Several communities have lost electrical service. This transmitter is operating on reserve power. Local repairs cannot restore the regional supply.

broadcasts.title: Limited assistance
broadcasts.text: Emergency assistance cannot reach the northern service roads. The town is overrun. Travel in daylight, treat water, and conserve medical supplies. There will be no further deliveries.

broadcasts.title: Final transmission
broadcasts.text: Our reserve power is almost exhausted. There will be no further scheduled reports from this station. If you are listening, find shelter and keep your people warm.
